atelier.hero.title:
You have a style.
Your website should, too.
atelier.hero.copy: Thoughtfully designed. Carefully built. We make websites that feel like you—and work for the people who use them.
atelier.hero.location: A SMALL STUDIO IN ISTANBUL. OPEN TO THE WORLD.
atelier.intro.label: HELLO, WE’RE ATASHALCI LABS.
atelier.intro.title:
A good website
makes you feel something.
atelier.intro.small:
A clear idea. A little character.
A lot of attention to detail.
atelier.intro.copy: We’re Atashalci Labs. A small, independent studio making websites with a clear purpose and a character of their own. From the first sketch to the final click, we bring design and development together.
atelier.services.label: WHAT WE DO
atelier.services.title:
From first idea
to the final full stop.
atelier.services.intro: A new beginning or a fresh direction for your existing site. We work on the story, the design and everything that makes it run.
atelier.services.cta: Tell us what you have in mind
atelier.service.1.title: Web design
atelier.service.1.copy: A visual direction that belongs to your business. We shape the content, structure and interface so visitors know who you are and where to go next.
atelier.service.1.list:
• Brand & business websites
  • Landing pages
  • Portfolio & editorial websites
  • Website redesigns
atelier.service.2.title: Web development
atelier.service.2.copy: We turn the design into a fast, responsive website. Clear structure, accessible controls and attention to the details that matter on every screen.
atelier.service.3.title: Creative interaction
atelier.service.3.copy: Sometimes a well-judged interaction tells the story better. We add movement and original details where they make the website clearer, more useful or more memorable.
atelier.service.3.list:
• Art direction for the web
  • Interactive typography
  • Motion & micro-interactions
  • Creative web experiences
atelier.studies.label: THE STUDIO SKETCHBOOK
atelier.studies.title: A few possibilities.
atelier.studies.copy: Self-initiated website explorations. Small studies in typography, layout and interaction—not commissioned client work. Try the details for yourself.
atelier.study.1.title: A fresh perspective.
atelier.study.1.copy: A little colour. A different rhythm. An editorial website study with three ways of seeing the same page.
atelier.study.2.title: Room to explore.
atelier.study.2.copy: For a considered first impression. An architectural composition that changes with the light.
atelier.study.3.title: Make an impression.
atelier.study.3.copy: For a launch with a point of view. One message, three moods. See how colour and type change its character.
atelier.editorial.title:
Everyday,
extraordinary.

atelier.spatial.title:
Less noise.
More presence.
atelier.spatial.status: Change the light. Keep the structure.
atelier.spatial.nightStatus: After dark — the same composition in a new light.
atelier.expressive.title:
Hello,
possibility.
atelier.expressive.status: Choose a mood. Watch the character change.
atelier.expressive.feedback: Warm — rounded type and a sunlit palette.
Bold — strong contrast and a sharper voice.
Quiet — fewer colours, a softer pace.
atelier.process.label: HOW WE WORK
atelier.process.title:
From hello
to launch.
atelier.process.copy: You work directly with us, from the first conversation to launch. Clear steps, shared decisions and space to get the details right.
atelier.process.1.title: Get to know you.
atelier.process.1.copy: Your business, your audience and what the website needs to do. We start with questions, then agree the scope.
atelier.process.2.title: Find the direction.
atelier.process.2.copy: We shape the pages, content and visual language. You review the design before we start building.
atelier.process.3.title: Make it work.
atelier.process.3.copy: We develop the site and check how it feels on phones, tablets and desktops. You see it take shape.
atelier.process.4.title: Ready for the world.
atelier.process.4.copy: Final checks, launch and a clear handover. We discuss any ongoing support as part of the project scope.
atelier.studio.label: TWO PEOPLE. ONE STUDIO.
atelier.studio.title:
Two people.
One good conversation.
atelier.studio.copy: We’re Arda and Onur, the partners behind Atashalci Labs. An independent studio in Istanbul, bringing design and development into the same conversation.
atelier.studio.direct: No long chain of handoffs. You talk to the people making your website.
atelier.contact.label: SOMETHING IN MIND?
atelier.contact.title:
Let’s make
your website.
atelier.contact.copy: A new website, a redesign or the start of an idea. Tell us a little about your business and what you need. A rough outline is a good place to begin.
atelier.error.title: A little off the page.
atelier.error.copy: This page isn’t here. Let’s take you back to the studio.
atelier.hero.subtitle: We design and build websites that express your business and feel right on every screen.
atelier.hero.reassurance: An idea is enough. We’ll work out the rest together.

reference.gallery.note: Illustrations of what we can make. These are self-initiated visual studies of our capabilities, not completed client projects.
reference.feature.design.title: Made for your world.
reference.feature.design.copy: Your website should feel like your business. We bring its story, structure and visual character together, giving people a clear way to understand what you do and take the next step.
reference.feature.development.title: Good design, working beautifully.
reference.feature.development.copy: We turn the design into a working website, with responsive layouts, accessible controls and carefully considered details. From the first page to the final check, we build around the people using it.
reference.feature.responsive.title: Every screen, considered.
reference.feature.responsive.copy: A website moves between phones, tablets and desktops. We consider content, navigation and interaction at each size, so the experience feels deliberate wherever someone meets your business.
reference.feature.launch.title: Something new to share.
reference.feature.launch.copy: A new business, a new product or a fresh idea. We shape focused landing pages that explain what matters, make the next step clear and give your launch a distinct visual voice.
reference.feature.content.title: Room for your story.
reference.feature.content.copy: Your website needs to grow with what you have to say. We plan clear content structures and, where the project calls for it, a practical way for you to make updates.
reference.feature.motion.title: A little more life.
reference.feature.motion.copy: Movement can guide the eye, explain an idea or bring a moment of surprise. We create thoughtful interactions that support your website’s purpose, with accessibility and performance in mind.
reference.brief.title: What’s on your mind?
reference.brief.copy: Tell us a little about your business and the website you have in mind. An early idea is a perfectly good place to start.
reference.brief.name: Your name
reference.brief.help: This prepares a draft in your email app. Review and send it there; nothing is submitted from this page.
reference.brief.success: Your draft is prepared. Open it in your email app to review and send. Nothing has been sent from this page.
reference.brief.error: We couldn’t prepare the draft. Please email us directly at info@atashalci.com.
reference.studio.title: So who are we?
reference.studio.copy: We’re Arda Çağan Ataş and Onur Salcı, the partners behind Atashalci Labs. We’re building an independent studio in Istanbul, focused on thoughtful website design and development. You work directly with us.
reference.process.title: From hello to launch.
reference.process.copy: A good website starts with a conversation. We get to know your business, agree a direction, build the pages and check the details together. Here’s how a project takes shape.
reference.expressive.title: One idea. Three moods.
reference.expressive.copy: A self-initiated web prototype exploring how colour, typography and movement change a page’s character. Try the controls and find your favourite direction. This is a studio experiment, not a commissioned client project.
reference.workflow.title: How we make it happen.
reference.workflow.1.title: First, we listen.
reference.workflow.1.copy: We talk about your business, your audience and what the website needs to achieve. Together, we agree the scope and priorities.
reference.workflow.2.title: Then, a direction.
reference.workflow.2.copy: We shape the content, page structure and visual language. You review the design and share feedback before development begins.
reference.workflow.3.title: Bring it to life.
reference.workflow.3.copy: We develop the website, refine the interactions and test it across screen sizes. You see the work take shape along the way.
reference.workflow.4.title: Ready for the world.
reference.workflow.4.copy: We complete the final checks, launch the site and walk you through the handover. Any ongoing support is agreed as part of the project.
reference.marquee.title: Let’s make your website.

products.purpose: Software for your customers. Tools for your team.
products.detail: We turn product ideas into SaaS applications and replace disconnected spreadsheets with internal tools shaped around your workflow.

intelligence.purpose: Less manual handoff. More considered action.
intelligence.detail: We connect knowledge, CRM and tasks through AI-assisted workflows, defining which steps can run automatically and which need human review.

experiences.purpose: A clear story. A distinctive experience.
experiences.detail: Websites and interfaces that make your offer understandable, with considered typography, interaction and 3D where they serve the experience.

engineering.purpose: From a working idea to a connected system.
engineering.detail: We shape the architecture, build the application and connect the APIs, then test the full flow and prepare the software for release.
